description: This file contains a SwiftUI extension for the CronSettings view, defining the user interface and associated logic for managing cron jobs within the application. It includes UI components such as headers, banners, job lists, detail views, and actions for creating, deleting, and refreshing cron jobs.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main view layout of the CronSettings UI, including headers, banners, job list, detail view, and actions, utilizing SwiftUI components and event handlers.

methods.name: schedulerBanner
methods.description: Displays a warning banner if the cron scheduler is disabled, including relevant path info and guidance.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Provides the top section of the UI with the title, description, and control buttons for refresh and creating new jobs.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Shows the main content area with error messages, the list of jobs, and a selection detail panel.

methods.name: detail
methods.description: Displays detailed information and run history for the selected cron job, or instructions when no job is selected.
